text:
nina: Quick sync — I ran the quarterly signal-convergence analysis for postmortem follow-ups. TL;DR: four recurring signals showing up across Dedicated + Private: model-load spikes during model swaps, autoscaler oscillations, KV-cache cold starts, and short cross-region network transients. Putting proposed owners and timelines here for alignment.

sam: Nice. Can you paste the top-line counts and a sample query?

nina: Counts from 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-01: model-load spikes = 12, autoscaler thrash = 9, kv-cold starts = 15, network-transients = 7. Quick query I used:```sql
SELECT root_cause, count(*) AS incidents
FROM incidents
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY root_cause
ORDER BY incidents DESC;
```

marco: kv-cold — is that concentrated on a particular model family or infra?

nina: Mostly large-context models (LlamaX family ~70%), some RedLM variants (~20%), and the remainder misc. Pattern: heavy prefix reuse + model swap causing cold KV loads.

ops-bot: analysis-bot created ticket INF-4217 for "KV cache cold starts — mitigation and monitoring"

leah: Proposed owners: marco -> KV cache follow-ups (2-week mitigation sprint), tony -> autoscaler tuning (RFC + small canary), sam -> model-load backpressure + rollout policy. Agree?

tony: :raised_hands: I can own autoscaler tuning. I'll draft an RFC and a canary plan. Suggest target: canary in 10 business days. Need perf harness access and a simple traffic replay.

sam: I'll own rollout policy and model-load backpressure. Can we add a runbook for rapid rollback during model swap?

nina: Done — created INF-4218 (Autoscaler tuning) and INF-4219 (Model-load: rollout/backpressure). Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4217 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4218 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4219. Each ticket has owner and a draft timeline (2 weeks to initial mitigation, 30 days for monitoring).

marco: Quick ask: can we add a new heartbeat metric for KV hit ratio and a per-model cold-start counter? That would make triage way faster.

nina: Added KV heartbeat metric and subtask on INF-4217. Please add the exact metric IDs to the ticket (e.g., kv.hit_ratio_v2).

leah: :thumbsup: Timeline check — target mitigations by end of sprint (2 weeks) and watch metrics for 30 days. Who is point for customer comms if this affects Dedicated tenants?

tony: I will coordinate with CS for customer comms and can own the initial outreach templates.

sam: I'll pair with marco on the runbook updates and we can add a small automated diagnostic (curl + trace capture) to the oncall workflow.

nina: Perfect. Action items recap: 1) INF-4217 marco — KV caching mitigation + metrics (target: 2w). 2) INF-4218 tony — autoscaler RFC + canary (target: 10 business days). 3) INF-4219 sam — rollout/backpressure runbook + diagnostic (target: 2w). I will run a follow-up checkpoint in two weeks and add status into the next ops retro. :rocket:

ops-bot: reminder-bot scheduled a follow-up checkpoint in #incidents two weeks from thread creation timestamp 2119812345.

nina: Thanks all — please update the tickets with PR links or docs and ping here if anything blocks. Closing the loop in the next quarterly incident review.
